audit.whatIsWrong: content.whys contradicts content.win and full.phases[].side on four of seven rows: whys[0] and whys[3] say 'You-favoured' where the chart says Skill, whys[5] says 'Skill' and whys[6] says 'Ambessa-favoured' where the chart says Darius. content.late and spikes[3] also argue Ambessa out-scales while the chart hands Darius both item stages.
audit.why: The chart is confirmed correct from both directions — champ-data/ambessa.full.js gives Skill/Darius/Darius/Skill/Skill/Darius/Darius with ratings that sum to 10 against this side on every row, and the win rates agree (51.56 here, 48.44 there). The prose is the half that is wrong.
audit.corrected: whys[0], whys[3], whys[5], whys[6], spikes[3] and late rewritten to match the mirror-confirmed chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike says her ultimate 'is a long-range dash-execute that repositions her out of your grasp mid-fight'. Public Execution does the opposite: it blinks her to the farthest enemy champion in a chosen line, suppresses that champion on arrival, then slams them for damage and a stun.
audit.why: The page teaches a player to expect her to leave the fight at 6. She arrives instead, and arrives with a suppress. A Darius who steps up expecting a disengage dies to it.
audit.corrected: Public Execution is 130/115/100 at 1250 range; in a 1v1 the farthest champion in the line is always you, so at 6 her ultimate is an engage, not an escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED ABILITY NAME: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability. It appears in focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, phases[3].why, phases[5].why, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.trading, breakdown.spikes, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.difficulty, dosFull[0] and dosFull[2] — the page's single most-repeated term is invented. Her real kit is Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). Separately, the decisive interaction in the lane is absent: Repudiation shields and braces, and if she blocks non-minion damage while bracing, the follow-up slam deals increased damage — so dumping Decimate into her W actively feeds her.
audit.why: Riot's Repudiation text: 'gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground... If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage.' Riot's Drakehound's Step text ties her dash to casting an ability, which is why 'wait for her mobility cooldown' is the wrong frame — there is no cooldown, there is a cast.
audit.corrected: Real names everywhere; the trade rule becomes 'never swing into a braced Repudiation' and 'punish the window right after she casts', not 'pull when her dashes are down'.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Ambessa cooldown appears anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Repudiation is 18/17/16/15/14, Lacerate 13/12/11/10/9, Cunning Sweep 14/13/12/11/10, Public Execution 130/115/100. Against Apprehend's 26s at rank 1, Repudiation's 18s is the window that actually decides whether your commit lands.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid, phases[5].why, dosFull[0].d and content.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ambessa is referred to as 'he' in breakdown.mid, breakdown.trading, tradeGood, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[0].d, and every dos/donts description is boilerplate that does not explain its own title.
audit.why: 'Pull when her mobility is down' is explained by 'Ambessa wastes Repeating Dashes' — a fabricated name and a wrong pronoun in the same two lines.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and each description rewritten to its own title with a real ability.
